summary: The filing is a Form 6-K containing a routine press release. Micromem Technologies Inc., a foreign private issuer, reports that it has advanced discussions with Canadian Defence stakeholders regarding potential deployment planning and unit-level commercialization of its wearable sensing platform. There is no transaction, no change in ownership, no tender offer, no restructuring, or other special situation. The filing includes no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no specific event warranting classification as a special situation. It is merely a progress update on ongoing collaborative research discussions.
